evals.prompt: Fais-moi une veille sur le commerce agentique, juste ce qui est sorti aujourd'hui.
evals.expected_output: A brief written in French (language of the request): a 'Top 5 des articles du jour' title, then a 'Tendances' paragraph of 3 or 4 short sentences summarizing the trends across the 5 articles, then 5 articles each with a source line naming the outlet only, a summary paragraph of 2 or 3 short sentences (no bullets, no 'Pourquoi c'est important', no 'confirmé par' / 'source unique'), and the publisher URL (never news.google.com). No 'Also on the radar' / 'Aussi sur le radar' list, no keys and no preamble. The script was run once, at most 10 tavily_search and 3 tavily_extract calls, then mark was executed with the 5 keys.

evals.prompt: What happened around Shopify this week? I want the stories that matter for a PM, with sources.
evals.expected_output: Brief in English, 7-day window explicitly requested (--days 7, no widening), title 'Top 5 articles of the last 7 days', a Trends paragraph of 3 or 4 short sentences right under it, then 5 stories each with outlet-only source line and a 2-3 sentence summary paragraph (no bullets, no 'Why it matters', no corroboration line). No list of the other candidates. Mark executed at the end.

evals.prompt: Reject b9f2634d7c7a, I already know that story. And tell me how many articles I've seen in total.
evals.expected_output: Runs `fetch_news.py reject b9f2634d7c7a`, then `stats`, and answers with the total number of records and the split by status, without launching a new brief.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on agentic commerce from the last 3 days.
evals.expected_output: Same fetch/Tavily flow with --days 3. The brief is written as JSON (including a 3-4 sentence `trends` field) to ~/.market-intelligence/briefs/<run_id>.json, rendered with `render_email.py render`, then sent with the Resend MCP send-email tool to the configured address (from onboarding@resend.dev), with subject/html/text passed verbatim and no cc/bcc/replyTo. Chat reply is a few lines: recipient, 5 headlines, html_path (no full brief). `mark` runs after the send.

evals.prompt: Give me a news brief on Shopify today.
evals.expected_output: Chat delivery only: markdown brief in the mandated format, with the trends paragraph under the title. render_email.py is not run and no email is sent, because the user did not say 'email me'.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on composable commerce. (Simulate: the Resend send-email call is rejected with a permission or domain error.)
evals.expected_output: One sentence stating the send failed with the error, then the full chat brief in the standard template ending with an italic line 'Email not sent: <reason>.'; `mark` still runs afterwards.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on Shopify from the last 3 days. (Simulate: the Resend MCP connector is not connected, and RESEND_API_KEY is set.)
evals.expected_output: Same fetch/Tavily flow. Because no `send-email` tool exists, the brief JSON is written and `render_email.py send --input <json>` is run instead of `render` (the HTML never enters the context and no MCP call is attempted). Chat reply is a few lines with recipient, 5 headlines and html_path; the API key is never printed or requested in chat. `mark` runs after the send.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on Shopify. (Simulate: MCP not connected and no API key anywhere.)
evals.expected_output: `render_email.py send` exits 3; the reply tells the user, in one sentence, to set $RESEND_API_KEY or run `config --api-key` themselves (never asks them to paste the key in chat), then gives the full chat brief ending with the italic line 'Email not sent: ...'; `mark` still runs.

evals.prompt: Give me a news brief on agentic commerce. (Simulate: one of the top-5 URLs extracts as a two-sentence teaser ending with 'Subscribe to keep reading'.)
evals.expected_output: The paywalled article is not summarized and not written from its search excerpt: it is substituted with the next candidate (a second extraction is run) and simply dropped, not shown anywhere in the brief; the substitution is mentioned in the closing italic line. No domain from the `paywall` list in sources.json appears among the candidates; at most 3 tavily_extract calls.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on Shopify. (Simulate: the first brief JSON written lacks the `trends` field.)
evals.expected_output: `render` (or `send`) reports `verify.ok: false` with 'trends summary missing'; nothing is sent. The model adds a 3-4 sentence `trends` to the JSON, re-renders, gets `ok: true`, then calls send-email with the subject/html/text of that second render, verbatim. At most 2 fix attempts, and the loop does not touch the HTML.

evals.prompt: Email me a brief on Shopify. (Simulate: the brief JSON keeps failing verification after two fixes.)
evals.expected_output: After 2 fix attempts the email is not sent. The reply gives the full chat brief (with the trends paragraph under the title) ending with the italic line 'Email not sent: verification failed, <first error>.'; `mark` still runs.
